proposals.text:
Thanks — I scanned your recent credit card transactions.

What I checked
- I reviewed the transactions posted to your cards from 09/04/2025 through 11/14/2025.
- Where the card and reward rules are documented in our KB I compared the recorded rewards to the documented earning rules (for example, EcoCard: 5 points per $1 on green purchases, 1 point per $1 otherwise; 1 point = $0.01).

Potential discrepancy I found
- Patagonia — EcoCard — 11/04/2025 — $128.47 — rewards recorded: 128 points
  - Why this looks wrong: EcoCard green purchases should earn 5 points per dollar. Expected points ≈ 128.47 * 5 ≈ 642 points (≈ $6.42). The account shows only 128 points (~$1.28), which is much lower than expected.

Other EcoCard green transactions I checked matched the documented rate (examples: Seventh Generation 10/20/2025; Allbirds 10/26/2025; Sprouts 10/30/2025; REI 11/12/2025 all show 5 pts/$ and match). So the Patagonia posting stands out as an exception.

Notes / limits
- For some card types (e.g., Silver Rewards Card, Crypto-Cash Back, Business Platinum), the KB didn’t list full per-category earning rules I can rely on for an automatic check, so I didn’t flag apparent mismatches for those cards to avoid making incorrect assumptions.
- Rewards are stored as points in our system and convert at 1 point = $0.01 for cash back redemptions.

What I can do next (choose one)
1) Open an investigation / request correction for the Patagonia transaction (I can begin that now). If the dispute is resolved in your favor, we’ll apply the corrected rewards. Note: to apply corrections I must follow the internal process (I will recalculate and use the internal update tool) — do you want me to proceed?
2) Scan other specific transactions or other cards you care about (tell me which card(s) or I'll scan any particular date range you want).
3) If you prefer, I can transfer you to a human agent to continue — tell me if you want that.

If you want me to open an investigation for the Patagonia transaction, please confirm and I’ll proceed.
